title: Merge two sorted lists
question: Merge [1,3] and [2,4] to [1,2,3,4].
initialCode:
a=[1,3]
b=[2,4]
res=[]
i=j=0
while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
    if a[i] <= b[j]:
        res.append(a[i]); i += 1
    else:
        res.append(b[j]); j += 1
res += a[i:] + b[j:]
print(res)
